scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server,gen -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run gen:watch"
scripts.dev:client: concurrently -n fable,fable-admin,vite -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run fable:watch" "npm run fable:watch:admin" "vite"
scripts.dev:server: concurrently -n fable-server,wrangler -c green,yellow "npm run fable:watch:server" "wrangler dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:admin && npm run build:server && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site: vite build && mkdir -p _site${BASE_PATH}/public _site${BASE_PATH}/lib && cp -r public/* _site${BASE_PATH}/public/ && cp lib/guest-session.js _site${BASE_PATH}/lib/ && { [ -z "${BASE_PATH}" ] || cp _site${BASE_PATH}/index.html _site/index.html; }
scripts.build:extension:all: npm run build:extension && npm run build:extension:firefox
scripts.deploy:wtfail: SITE_SLUG=wtfail SITE_TITLE="WT.Fail" ADMIN_TITLE="WT.Fail Admin" SITE_LOGO="/public/wtfail.png" npm run build && wrangler deploy --env wtfail
scripts.deploy:idealist: SITE_SLUG=idealist BASE_PATH=/st SITE_TITLE="id-ea.li/st" ADMIN_TITLE="id-eAdmin" SITE_LOGO="/public/idealist.jpg" npm run build && wrangler deploy --env idealist
scripts.deploy:usbase: SITE_SLUG=usbase SITE_TITLE="US Base" ADMIN_TITLE="USBase Admin" SITE_LOGO="/public/usbase.gif" npm run build && wrangler deploy --env usbase
